messageEn: Version 1.0.14: expandable daily ayah on Home, better players and playback speed, Mushaf Plain WebView (should fix long-standing edge clipping), share cards for azkar and ayahs (new button in Azkar to prepare a status), prayer and azkar polish, stability fixes.
